theorem momentMap_measurable [MeasurableSpace 𝓨] [BorelSpace 𝓨]
    (P : Kernel Θ 𝓧) (T : 𝓧 → 𝓨) (hT : StronglyMeasurable T) :

  exact hT.integral_kernel.measurable
